personality_one_liner: Clean, native layout framing automotive services clearly, prioritizing trust, real imagery, and fast utility.

spacing.rule: Handle spacing correctly dont have extra spaces where its not required, handle padding and margin corectly and subtle for buttons and components

do's: Use glass on bottom tab bar
Use glass on sticky headers over scrolling content
Use glass on FABs layered over maps
Use on featured hero cards overlaying photos
dont's: Do not use glass on form inputs or standard list rows
Do not use glass if it impairs text legibility

screens.name: Home
screens.purpose: Discover and browse featured and local automotive workshops.

states.loading: Centered spinner with a subtle skeleton for the featured card.
states.empty: Illustration of an empty garage + 'No workshops found matching your filters' + Clear Filters button.

screens.layout: Sticky search bar at the top (under safe area). Below that, a horizontal scrolling chip row for categories (Mecánica, Pintura, etc.) using brandTertiary for unselected and brandPrimary for selected. Below, a horizontal carousel of 'Featured Workshops' full-bleed cards with photos, gradient scrims, and text anchored at bottom. Underneath, a vertical list of nearby workshops (Yelp style: image on left, title, rating, and contextual badges like distance on right).

screens.name: Map
screens.purpose: Locate nearby workshops visually on a map.

states.loading: Map loads with a subtle pulse effect.
states.empty: Map shows default Chile center, toast indicating no nearby workshops.
states.error: Map fails to load, text overlay 'Unable to load map' + Retry.

screens.layout: Full-screen map layer taking up flex: 1. Floating glass search bar at top. Floating Action Button (glass) for 'My Location' at bottom right. A @gorhom/bottom-sheet that peaks slightly, showing a list of workshops in the current viewport. Tapping a map pin fully opens the bottom sheet with that specific workshop's detail card.

screens.name: Favorites
screens.purpose: Quick access to saved and frequently visited workshops.

states.empty: Empty street night image + 'No favorite workshops yet' + 'Explore Workshops' CTA.

screens.layout: Simple, clean vertical list. Each list item has 56pt minimum height, leading image thumbnail, title, rating, and chevron right. Swipe-to-delete gesture available on rows.

screens.name: WorkshopDetail
screens.purpose: View comprehensive details of a specific workshop and initiate contact.
screens.layout: Scrollable view. Top hero image using expo-image with a 3-stop vertical gradient scrim (transparent to 70% surfaceInverse). Workshop title overlaid at the bottom of the scrim. Immediately below the hero, a horizontal row of icon-only or short-text action pills (Call, WhatsApp, Directions). Sections follow: 'Services Offered' (wrapping chips), 'Description' (body text), 'Opening Hours' (key-value rows), and 'Ratings'. A sticky CTA at the very bottom 'Contact Workshop' anchored above the home indicator.

screens.name: Profile
screens.purpose: Manage app settings and user info.
screens.layout: Native iOS-style settings list. Each row uses a tinted icon container on the left (brandTertiary with brandPrimary icon), text, and a right chevron. Content grouped into 'Account', 'Preferences', and 'About'.

hero_featured.alt: Front view of an auto repair shop with roll-up doors

cat_brakes.alt: Detailed view of car brake caliper

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly adhere to the '1 iOS-Native Clean' personality: Generous vertical padding, clear grouping, no muddy colors, frame content with UI.
Do NOT use any blue, indigo, or purple. Stick to the provided Moss Green (brand) and Charcoal (onSurface/Inverse) palette.
Implement horizontal chip row for workshop categories on the Home screen.
Apply gradient scrims over any text resting on images (e.g., featured carousel and workshop detail hero). Use a 3-stop vertical gradient from transparent to 70% surfaceInverse.
Build the Map view using a full-screen layout with floating glass actions and a gorhom bottom-sheet for displaying location lists.
Always preserve Safe Area. Ensure the sticky CTA on the Workshop Detail screen stays above the home indicator.
Wire subtle haptics to the category chips, tab changes, and primary action buttons (like Call or WhatsApp).
List rows should emulate modern directories (like Yelp) with left-aligned imagery and contextual right-aligned details (ratings, distance).
Learnings from research: Optimize card-based layouts to balance visuals and actionable data. Keep context badges (ratings, category) visible but not overwhelming.
